Good hostel with ample facilities. Mess is also available here. The rooms here consists of 4 bed, 6bed, 9bed, and 15 beded.
The rooms are cleaned daily by the cleaners, moreover it is located at the prime location of CSMT and marine drive is also very close to it .
Security is quiet good and the passages are equipped with camera's. Admission first preference is given to the Anjuman Students and then the other institute students.though they serve only breakfast and dinner but the quality of the food is excellent. Also, 4 days in a week they serve Chicken in dinner and milk everyday. The hostel warden is quiet supportive and understanding. The rooms are WIFI enabled and has proper ventilation. The yearly fees varies from 80,000 to 1,05,000 rs. The hostel has got a big study room with proper desk and chairs open 24X7 for studies. Moreover hostel has got a mosque in the campus and a big playground. The hostel has 5 floors and has a capacity of more than 180 students.

featured_reviews.name: Rakshit Khilnani
featured_reviews.review_text: They portray themselves as disciplinarian but it's regressive in nature to expect legal adults to follow out-of-date rules. I understand that Mumbai has a housing issue and every place with accommodation will be sought after, but that does not mean you impose regressive ideologies and restrictive rules (these rules would be illegal in any developed country) on desperate students. The students will find like minded peers but they're students - if you can't provide food then don't expect them to come back in by 11pm if they're working, studying or enjoying during class vacations. The horrendous management are unresponsive but also have no boundaries and clearly flout individual privacy for nosy 'checks' and curfews - having experienced hostels in other countries as well while studying with totally responsible cultures, RSM has a suffocating culture with no respect for freedom, boundaries and artistic expression. The facilities are cramped, barely adequate furnishing, no kitchen to cook healthy food as a student and have below average hygiene levels with minimal maintenance. If you care for your/ your child's mental health I suggest you look elsewhere. I know people (like me) who were kicked out on to the streets within the day for trivial reasons to stroke the management's ego and power complex and you're risking your accommodation, in a crucial academic time, to the whims and fancies and a rigid megalomania of the crazy family run intrusive management.
